column1: # Dual-OTA layout for 4MB flash: two app slots (firmware OTA) + LittleFS (blocklist).
# espressif32 platform 8.x builds the firmware at ~1.40MB (older cores: ~1.24MB)
# app slots are 1.4375MB each (~100KB headroom). That leaves 1.0625MB for the blocklist
# (~200k domains @ 5 bytes; the default StevenBlack + Hagezi Light list is ~0.65MB).
